title: Modern UI redesign with reliable social redirects, forms, timers, submission logs, and site search

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive modern visual redesign (typography, spacing, colors, and consistent component styling) without breaking any existing routes.
acceptanceCriteria: All existing routes render without layout breakage on mobile and desktop.
A single consistent design system is applied (type scale, spacing rhythm, card/button/input styles, and section backgrounds).
Animations (if any) respect reduced-motion preferences and do not introduce continuous heavy effects.

file_operations.description: Refine the global design system tokens and utilities (type scale, spacing helpers, consistent section styling, background surfaces), and ensure reduced-motion behavior remains respected across all animations.
Align Tailwind theme extensions (colors, fonts, radii, shadows, animations) to the redesigned system for consistent styling across pages.
Wrap all routes in a consistent page shell (header + content + footer) so every existing route inherits the redesign uniformly while keeping router behavior intact.
Restyle the header to match the new design system (modern spacing/typography, clearer active states, consistent surfaces) while preserving all existing navigation targets.
Restyle footer layout/typography/surfaces to match the redesign and ensure icon/link styling is consistent with the new design system.
Polish bottom navigation styling and active states to match the updated design system, maintaining accessibility and route reachability.
Add the generated asset for the redesigned hero background at frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png and wire it into the redesigned UI as a static asset.
Add the generated minimal monoline icon set at frontend/public/assets/generated/ui-icons.dim_512x512.png and wire it into the redesigned UI where appropriate as a static asset.
Add the generated section divider graphic at frontend/public/assets/generated/section-divider.dim_1920x240.png and wire it into the redesigned UI as a static asset.

requirements.summary: Fix all Telegram/WhatsApp redirects to consistently use SOCIAL_LINKS constants and open in a new tab/window.
acceptanceCriteria: All UI links that claim to open Telegram open https://t.me/Rsuperior.
All UI links that claim to open WhatsApp channel open https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbB6FHV59PwWv9wIE93P.
All UI flows that claim to open WhatsApp direct message open https://wa.me/923294238997 (with optional encoded message querystring when applicable).
No hardcoded Telegram/WhatsApp URLs remain outside frontend/src/constants/socialLinks.ts.

file_operations.description: Audit and retain the existing Telegram/WhatsApp URLs as the single source of truth; ensure exports remain stable and are referenced everywhere else (no URL changes).
Ensure Telegram/WhatsApp icons use SOCIAL_LINKS exclusively and open with target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer; remove any hardcoded social URLs if present.
Audit any Telegram/WhatsApp links/buttons in header/mobile menu to use SOCIAL_LINKS exclusively and open in a new tab/window where applicable.
Ensure any social links on the Contact page use SOCIAL_LINKS (no hardcoded Telegram/WhatsApp URLs) and open in a new tab/window.
Ensure WhatsApp URL generation uses SOCIAL_LINKS.whatsappDirect consistently and supports optional encoded prefilled messages for form flows.

requirements.summary: Make Presale and Airdrop registration submissions reliable with validation, clear toasts, disabled/loading states, and WhatsApp redirect + popup-blocked fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting Presale/Airdrop with valid data calls the backend submitForm successfully and shows a success toast.
Submitting invalid data does not call the backend and shows a validation error.
While submission is in progress, the active form is disabled and shows an in-progress UI state.
After successful submission, WhatsApp opens with a correctly encoded, prefilled message that matches the submitted values.
If the popup is blocked, the UI provides a clear fallback (e.g., a visible link/button) that the user can click to open WhatsApp manually.

file_operations.description: Harden Presale/Airdrop submission flow: prevent submission when locked, validate before submit, show consistent success/error toasts, ensure per-form disabled/loading states, and expose a clear WhatsApp fallback link/button when popup opening is blocked.

Ensure the form submission mutation surfaces actionable error states (for toast display) and reliably invalidates relevant queries after success (including mySubmissions and any timer-related UI dependencies).
Update WhatsApp opening helper to detect blocked popups (e.g., window.open returns null) and return a result that the UI can use to show a manual fallback link.
Tighten form validation/normalization to ensure robust required-field errors in English, and consistent payload normalization for both Presale and Airdrop.
Do not modify this file; instead, verify toast usage remains consistent with the redesign. (This operation is a placeholder—skip implementation changes if this path is immutable.)

requirements.summary: Implement timer-based locking/unlocking for Presale/Airdrop forms driven strictly by backend timer values, with smooth countdown updates and clear English lock messaging.
acceptanceCriteria: When remaining time is 0 (or otherwise indicates lock), the corresponding form is visibly locked and cannot be submitted (UI prevents submit; backend rejects if attempted).
When remaining time is greater than 0 and the form is intended to be available, the form is usable and can be submitted.
The UI countdown updates smoothly and matches the latest backend remaining-time queries.
Locked-state messaging is clear and in English.

file_operations.description: Refactor timer handling so the countdown decreases smoothly client-side between backend refreshes while staying aligned to backend remaining-time queries; enforce locked state both in UI controls and submit handlers, with clear English messaging.
Adjust timer queries/refetch strategy to keep UI in sync with backend remaining-time values and minimize drift (without adding auth requirements).
Ensure timer processing supports backend nanosecond values robustly (including edge cases like negative/zero), producing consistent formatted display and locked-state signals.

requirements.summary: Add a simple 'My Submissions' UI log that reflects successful submissions with timestamps and stays consistent with backend-stored records.
acceptanceCriteria: After submitting a form, the UI displays an entry in a "My Submissions" area (or equivalent) that includes: form type (Presale/Airdrop), submitted timestamp, and key submitted fields.
The log is fetched from backend getMySubmissions and updates automatically after successful submission.
No other user’s submissions are visible to a non-admin user.

file_operations.description: Create a 'My Submissions' component that fetches and renders the current user's submissions from useGetMySubmissions with a simple list/table presentation and clear empty/loading states. Use shadcn-ui components for list/table/card styling as needed. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Confirm mySubmissions query is enabled appropriately and is invalidated/refetched after successful submitForm so the UI updates immediately.
Wire the new MySubmissions component into the Acquisition page near the Presale/Airdrop forms so users can see their submission log after submitting.

requirements.summary: Fix all other site form submissions to validate clearly in English, provide success/error feedback, and prevent accidental double submits.
acceptanceCriteria: Each page with a form provides English validation errors for required fields.
Each form submission path provides a clear success indicator and a clear failure indicator (no silent failures).
No form can be submitted multiple times unintentionally due to missing disabled/loading handling.

file_operations.description: Ensure the contact form has explicit required-field validation messaging in English, uses disabled/loading state to prevent double submits, and always shows a clear toast on success/failure.

Audit any access/passcode or other form-like interactions to ensure clear validation, visible success/failure feedback (toast or inline), and disabled/loading states to prevent double submits. Use shadcn-ui components for consistent UX. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Audit any alert creation/edit/delete dialogs/forms to ensure consistent validation feedback, explicit success/error messaging, and disabled/loading states during mutations. Use shadcn-ui dialog/form primitives as-is (compose only). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Refine user-facing error sanitization so form-related failures consistently display clear, English error messages (and avoid exposing raw technical details).

requirements.summary: Implement a working site-wide search box for multipage routing that navigates to matched routes without authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: A visible search input exists in the UI (desktop and mobile).
Typing a query shows matching results (at minimum: page titles/primary sections) and selecting a result navigates to the corresponding route.
Search works without requiring authentication.
Empty/no-match states are handled gracefully with English messaging.

file_operations.description: Create a site search component (input + results) that indexes known routes/page titles and navigates via the router on selection. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., command/menu/dialog/input) to provide accessible interactions and consistent styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a small static search index mapping existing routes to titles/keywords (and optional section hints) to support fast client-side search without external services.
Wire the SiteSearch component into the header for desktop and mobile layouts so search is always visible/accessible without authentication.
Add an optional search affordance in bottom navigation for mobile users (either a search item that opens the search UI or a compact input), ensuring it does not break existing navigation.

requirements.summary: Preserve multipage router navigation while improving usability via clearer navigation and consistent page shells and scroll behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: All existing routes remain accessible via navigation on both desktop and mobile.
No route becomes unreachable due to redesign changes.
Scroll position behavior remains sensible on route changes (no confusing partial scroll states).

file_operations.description: Ensure the multipage router layout includes consistent header/footer/bottom nav across all routes and keeps all existing routes reachable; confirm notFound handling remains intact.
Verify scroll-to-top behavior on route changes remains predictable with the redesigned fixed header and ensure it does not create confusing partial scroll states.
Standardize page container spacing and responsive paddings so all pages share a consistent shell and improved readability across mobile/desktop.
Improve navigation clarity (grouping, active states, mobile menu usability) while keeping all existing routes present and accessible.
